Name: Lilacor - The Talking Sword (Remastered)
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[b]You come upon a powerful sword. Unfortunately, it's also opinionated.
[/b]
Lilacor is an enchanted sentient weapon with an ancient and extremely complicated relationship with his own legacy. He has been in wars. He has sacked cities. He has attended the fall of empires. He is currently on your farm watching you water parsnips and he has a lot to say about it...and everything else.
[b]
✦ Major Update ✦
[/b]
[b][u]Acquisition[/u][/b]
Lilacor is found by completing the Sewer Bundle, available via the [b]Unlockable Bundles[/b] mod (required). Discovery letters arrive from Marlon or Krobus depending on whether you've obtained the Rusty Key. Completing the bundle adds Lilacor to your inventory and starts everything else.

[u][b]Upgrade System[/b][/u]
Lilacor now has upgrade tiers, each unlocked through Clint. Stats increase with each upgrade. 

Sharpened (5 iron bars, 5000g) --> Reinforced (5 gold bars, 10,000g) --> Restored (5 iridium bars, 20,000g)

Clint sends a letter after you've owned the sword for a few days. Enter Clint's shop with the material he requests and it will trigger a short cutscene - Lilacor may have something to say about this. The other letters follow with each upgrade.

[b][u]Dialogue[/u][/b]
Lilacor now has 385 lines of dialogue. He has NPC specific lines for each villager and includes lines for NPC's from most major expansion mods (Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, Ridgeside Village and Sunberry Village). He also has a pool of random quotes that have a chance to trigger.

He reacts to nearly everything:
[list]
[*]Selecting him from your inventory[/*]
[*]Swinging in combat[/*]
[*]Killing enemies[/*]
[*]Taking damage[/*]
[*]Entering the Mines, Volcano, or Sewer for the first time[/*]
[*]Reaching floor 120[/*]
[*]Talking to NPCs [/*]
[*]Festivals[/*]
[*]Being put in a chest (once, and he will not forget it)[/*]
[/list]All dialogue chances and cool downs are configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu. A mute toggle is available if you need a break from him. He will have something to say about that too.

[b][u]Friendship System[/u][/b]
You can now become friends with Lilacor and earn his trust . Fight with him equipped, explore dungeons, reach milestones — earn hearts. Neglect him, die repeatedly, stuff him in a chest and you will lose hearts. 

Points are earned through:
[list]
[*]Kills while equipped[/*]
[*]Time spent in dungeons[/*]
[*]Reaching floor 100, floor 120, and Skull Cavern for the first time[/*]
[*]Being equipped at least once per day[/*]
[/list]Points are lost through:
[list]
[*]Player death[/*]
[*]Being placed in a chest[/*]
[/list][b]Status Menu[/b]
Right-click Lilacor in your inventory (or press X on controller) to open the status menu. Shows:
[list]
[*]A rotating greeting quote [/*]
[*]Heart meter and score progress[/*]
[*]Lilacor's current opinion of you[/*]
[*]Stats: enemies defeated, days together, dungeon floors visited[/*]
[*]A tier quote that changes as the relationship develops[/*]
[/list][b][u]New Heart Events[/u][/b]
Five events tell Lilacor's story from contempt to something he would never admit out loud.

[b]2 Hearts — The Wizard's Tower[/b] Reach 2 Lilacor hearts. Enter the Wizard's Tower.
[b]4 Hearts — The Adventure Guild[/b] Reach 4 Lilacor hearts. Enter the Adventure Guild.
[b]6 Hearts — The Wizard's Tower[/b] Reach 6 Lilacor hearts. Have seen the 2-heart event. Enter the Wizard's Tower.
[b]8 Hearts — The Mine Entrance[/b] Reach 8 Lilacor hearts. Enter the mine entrance.
[b]10 Hearts — The Beach[/b] Reach 10 Lilacor hearts. Visit the beach between 7pm and 2am.

[b][u]✦Compatibility✦[/u][/b]

[list]
[*][b] Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] - Full NPC quote support for SVE characters including Lance, Morgan, Olivia, and others. Lilacor has   assessed them all.[/*]
[*][b] East Scarp[/b] - Complete quote coverage. Eyvind gets special treatment. That name demands it.[/*]
[*][b] Sword & Sorcery[/b] - Hector and Mateo are the first people in this valley Lilacor has considered professional equals.[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village  [/b]- Lilacor is a big fan of the semi-murderous ninja junimo.[/*]
[*][b]Sunberry Village [/b]- The demons are of particular interest to him.[/*]
[*][b]Other weapon mods[/b] - Lilacor only speaks when he's in your inventory. He is not responsible for what other swords say.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Acknowledgements[/u][/b]
**I'm a huge fan of Baldur's Gate 2: Shadows of Amn and this mod is an homage to the game developers and the sword you can obtain in the sewers in Act I. Effort was made to preserve the spirit and humor without stepping on any creative toes**

[b]Give this an endorsement if you like it so more people can see it and be heckled by Lilacor.[/b]

Manifest.Name: Lilacor - The Talking Sword
Manifest.Description: Adds Lilacor, a legendary sentient sword with a centuries-old ego problem. He comments on combat, NPCs, your life choices, and occasionally reveals something almost sincere about his past. Includes two Wizard events, letters from Krobus and Marlon, and over 200 lines of dialogue.
Manifest.Author: CozyPsychologist

Manifest.Description: Adds the Sewer Bundle for Lilacor. Requires Unlockable Bundles and Lilacor - The Talking Sword.
Manifest.Author: CozyPsychologist
